title: FOIA / public records request: evidence redaction and release
summary: Public records requests from a form to release: statutory SLA, evidence gathering, AI-assisted redaction of video, photos, audio and documents, legal approval and an exemptions log.
description:
Public records requests (US FOIA and state public records acts, the NZ Official Information Act, the UK Freedom of Information Act or your own policy) start on a standalone form page: the requester gives their details, the records they want, the date range and how to receive them. The workflow gives the request a reference, looks up the response deadline in a configurable rules table, sets an SLA to match and emails an acknowledgement with the date.

A records officer attaches the responsive records: body-worn camera or CCTV video, photos, interview audio and documents. Redact Video blurs faces, licence plates and on-screen ID numbers and bleeps personal details it hears; Redact Image does the same for each photo; the interview is transcribed, bleeped and its transcript redacted; Redact Document finds personal information in the statement for review. Each item gets a proposed exemption in the Exemptions log.

A legal reviewer compares every original with its redacted copy (originals stay restricted to the request and are never released) and approves a full or partial release, denies it or sends it back. On release the document is redacted, the cover letter and exemption log become PDFs merged into a release package, and the requester gets the package by email or a download link. No-records, extension and denial letters are included, every step is written to an audit trail table, and a 7-year retention policy is applied. Redaction aids the reviewer; it does not replace them, and the deadline and exemption rows are examples to adapt with your counsel, not legal advice.
start: Starts from a form page: share the Public records request form (/f/<id>) on your website; each submission starts the workflow.
setup: Google Gemini (media AI): paste your API key from aistudio.google.com. Redaction runs with your own key; to use another provider (OpenAI, Azure AI Vision, AWS) add that integration and choose it on the media steps.
Records release portal: set the base URL and token of the system that hosts download links (or remove the Create release link step and send attachments only).
Assignees: pick the records officer who gathers records and the legal reviewer who approves releases.

Review the Records request rules and Exemption codes tables with your counsel: the rows are examples (deadline counts, day types, extensions and exemption codes differ by statute and agency). They are not legal advice.

Apply the "Records requests: 7 years" retention policy to the Records requests, Exemptions log and Request activity tables to match your records schedule, and set EMAIL_PROVIDER so requesters receive their letters.
Background media steps need FFmpeg (Docker image or FFMPEG_PATH) and the media job scheduler (process-media) running, as for any long video.

steps.title: Request form
steps.body: The requester fills in the themed form page: who they are, the law, the records sought, dates and delivery preference.

steps.title: Deadline and SLA
steps.body: The rules table gives the statutory days (for example 20 business days, 10 state days or 20 working days), an approximate calendar due date and default exemption codes; the run SLA and the register use it.

steps.title: Acknowledge
steps.body: The requester is emailed the reference and the response date.

steps.title: Gather records
steps.body: The records officer attaches video, photos, interview audio and documents, or answers No records (letter) or Extend deadline (new SLA and notice).

steps.title: Automated redaction
steps.body: Redact Video blurs faces, plates and on-screen text and bleeps personal details in the speech; each photo goes through Redact Image; the interview is transcribed and bleeped; the document is checked for personal information. Each item gets a proposed exemption in the log.

steps.title: Legal review
steps.body: The legal reviewer compares originals with redacted copies, confirms the exemption codes and approves, approves in part, denies or sends back.

steps.title: Release package
steps.body: The document is redacted, the cover letter and exemption log become PDFs merged into one package, and the requester receives it by email or download link.

steps.title: Audit and retention
steps.body: Every step is recorded in the Request activity table and the request row gets the 7-year retention policy.

sample_input.records_sought: Body-worn camera video, photos, the witness interview and statement for incident SAMPLE-2026-0042 on Sample Street.
